title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
summary: The rollout dates, administrator installation requirement, control paths and Graph calls are supported. One minor clarification is needed: Microsoft's declarative-agent guide and registration API reference use different names for the authentication configuration property.

claims.claim: Agent 365 agents implementing A2A can be connected agents in declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing support for Microsoft Agent 365 agents that implement the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, allowing them to be used as connected agents in declarative agents built with Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes use within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents

claims.claim: Copilot selects a connected agent using its name, description and example prompts.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot evaluates the connected agents declared in the manifest and selects one based on the current task and the connected agent's name, description, and example prompts.

claims.claim: Copilot sends the selected connected agent a text request.
claims.quote: Copilot sends a text request to the selected connected agent

claims.claim: Copilot incorporates the connected agent's text response into the ongoing user interaction.
claims.quote: receives a text response, and incorporates that response into the declarative agent's ongoing interaction with the user.

claims.quote: Agents with Agent2Agent agent cards return text, Base64 image binaries, and Base64 file binaries.

claims.claim: The declarative agent handles the connected agent's returned output.

claims.claim: The registration references an existing authentication registration through an authorization object.
claims.quote: the registration references an existing authentication registration through the authorization object in the agentRegistration.
claims.fix: Add: 'The declarative-agent guide calls this object `authorization`; the registration API update reference instead names `a2aAuthorization`.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/agent-registration/agentregistration-update, whose request-body table describes a2aAuthorization as 'Authorization configuration used to invoke an Agent2Agent server.'

claims.quote: Searched: Agent2Agent connected agents Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing Copilot Credits meter charge; opened connected-agent guide, Agent 365 overview and service description. No A2A-agent-specific price or separate-charge rule found.
